title: Set up Claude Code on the dev machine
body:
Goal: Claude Code installed and configured with the project's working rules.
Acceptance: CLAUDE.md (global rules, agent ownership, feature routing; under 200 lines); .claude/settings.json (model sonnet, permissions.ask for git commit/push and gh pr, env CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL=sonnet and CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH=1); subagent files in .claude/agents/ (always-available tier + reviewers); token setup (effort medium, Gradle output-filter hook, prompt suggestions off, codebase-overview skill stub); ticket-workflow skill written. Verified: small task planned and executed on Sonnet; after /model opusplan a task plans in Opus and executes on Sonnet; work delegated to the right subagent (/tasks); a git commit attempt prompts for permission.
Note: repo does not exist yet; project-level files are committed in M0-1 when approved.
Skill: ticket-workflow.

title: Create the monorepo
body:
Goal: public monorepo with composeApp/, shared/, server/, docs/.
Acceptance: Gradle multi-module build; license added; .gitignore covers keystores, .env, local.properties; .env.example exists.
Skills: codebase-overview, domain-glossary.

title: KMP skeleton - Android target only
body:
Goal: Compose Multiplatform app runs on Android with UI in commonMain.
Acceptance: version catalog (libs.versions.toml); iOS target declared but disabled or stubbed.

title: Add and adapt KMP skills
body:
Goal: the project carries the Katanime Android/KMP skills, renamed kmp-* and adapted to this repo.
Acceptance: 8 skills at .claude/skills/kmp-<name>/SKILL.md; renamed name and cross-references; content describes the flat layout (androidApp, composeApp, shared, server) with package-by-feature, SQLDelight, Apollo, Koin, Android-first; no leftover Katanime module paths or Room references.
Out of scope: code changes in the app modules.

title: Lint, formatting, static checks
body:
Goal: consistent style enforced.
Acceptance: ktlint or Spotless plus detekt run locally and in CI; pre-commit hook or documented command.

title: CI pipeline
body:
Goal: GitHub Actions builds Android and server.
Acceptance: unit tests and lint run; README badge; no secrets for fork PRs.
Skill: gradle-ci (covers M0-3 lint commands).

title: Server skeleton
body:
Goal: runnable Ktor server.
Acceptance: GET /health; env-based config (HOST, PORT, APP_ENV, LOG_LEVEL); structured logging (readable in dev, JSON in prod); tests for /health and config; ktor-server-conventions skill written.
Skill: ktor-server-conventions.

title: Docker Compose for local dev
body:
Goal: one-command local environment.
Acceptance: docker compose up starts Postgres and the server; works from the README alone.

title: Spike: GraphQL server library
body:
Goal: choose the Kotlin GraphQL server library. Time-box 1 to 2 days.
Acceptance: hello-world query in at least two candidates (Expedia graphql-kotlin, KGraphQL, Apollo server tooling); decision in docs/decisions/0001-graphql-server.md covering maintenance, Ktor compatibility, schema approach, subscriptions.

title: Spike: shared contract strategy
body:
Goal: decide GraphQL schema as contract (Apollo generates client models) versus shared Kotlin DTOs.
Acceptance: decision record written; affects feature routing order (server first).
Skill: graphql-schema, written once M0-7 and M0-8 are both decided.

title: Decision records setup
body:
Goal: ADR process in place.
Acceptance: ADR template in docs/decisions/; README skeleton with architecture section.
Skill: adr.

title: Apollo Kotlin setup in shared
body:
Goal: Apollo wired into shared.
Acceptance: Gradle plugin and schema file configured; a trivial query generates Kotlin models; builds from clean; Apollo version pinned.

title: Server GraphQL endpoint with hello query
body:
Goal: /graphql serves a hello query.
Acceptance: checkable in GraphiQL or similar; schema exported to the file the client uses.

title: Postgres schema v1 and migrations
body:
Goal: first database schema.
Acceptance: Flyway runs on startup; list_entry with ID, user ID placeholder, internal anime ID (mal_id on the anime table), status, updated_at, deleted_at tombstone; integration test with Testcontainers or similar.
Skill: postgres-migrations.

title: Local database in shared
body:
Goal: SQLDelight local store as source of truth.
Acceptance: same table shape as the server plus sync_state column (pending, synced); repository functions in commonMain; tests in commonTest.
Skill: testing-conventions.

title: Push mutation and pull query
body:
Goal: sync protocol on the server.
Acceptance: pushChanges accepts a batch with client-generated IDs and is idempotent; changesSince(cursor) returns changes and tombstones; server tests.
Out of scope: conflict handling beyond last-write-wins; auth.
Skill: sync-protocol.

title: Sync worker on the client
body:
Goal: client sync loop.
Acceptance: push pending then pull new, mark synced, store the cursor; scheduling behind an interface (WorkManager on Android).

title: Minimal UI
body:
Goal: trivial screen over the local DB.
Acceptance: one Compose screen lists local entries, adds one, shows sync state; reads only from the local DB.

title: End-to-end check
body:
Goal: prove the walking skeleton.
Acceptance: offline add, reconnect, entry reaches the server; a second install pulls it; short result note in docs/.
Checkpoint: clone-and-run works from the README; offline edits sync after reconnect; all logic in commonMain apart from the Android scheduler; CI, lint and tests pass on main.
